ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - WinRM Access Via Evil-WinRM
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may use Valid Accounts to log into a computer using the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP). The adversary may then perform actions as the logged-on user.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\ruby\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-i\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-u\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-p\\ .*")))
